summary: Correctly fixes the boolean-weights normalization bug (GH4074) by casting bool weights to int before the dot-product reduction; minimal, well-commented, and behavior for non-bool dtypes is unchanged.

issues.description: Branching duplicates the `self._reduce(...)` call; a single `weights = self.weights.astype(int) if self.weights.dtype == bool else self.weights` would be tidier, but this is a cosmetic nit.
